Studydown

Support

Clear help with face-down timing, access, restoring your purchase, and managing files.

Common questions

How do I start?

Choose or create an Activity, start the timer, and place the iPhone flat and still with its screen facing down. Studydown records once that position is detected.

Why did the timer not start?

Confirm that the iPhone is almost flat, still, and Studydown is active. A steep angle or constant movement can prevent detection.

Free: 3 Activities, 5 minutes

Keep up to 3 Activities and 300 seconds (5 minutes) of total recorded time, with Today and This Week summaries and a basic CSV file. This is not a daily allowance. Lifetime Pro removes both limits; a face-down session already underway is saved without trimming.

Lifetime Pro

One lifetime purchase unlocks unlimited Activities, monthly, yearly, and custom analysis, weekly goals, Deadlines, Apple Watch, Widgets, advanced hero styles, and complete JSON backup and restore. No subscription.

How do I restore Lifetime Pro?

Open the Lifetime Pro screen and select Restore Purchases while signed in to the Apple Account used to buy it. Apple confirms the entitlement.

How are CSV and JSON different?

Basic CSV is included free for tabular records. Lifetime Pro adds complete JSON backup and restore. Files are created only when requested and saved to a destination you select.

How can I check a short session?

In Settings, set Shortest session to keep to 3 seconds. Choose an Activity, tap Start timing, and keep the iPhone still and face down for at least 10 seconds after detection. Keep Studydown active and the phone unlocked. Lift it and end the session or let the grace period expire. Sessions shorter than your chosen minimum are discarded.

How do I change reminders?

In Settings, turn reminders on or off and choose a daily time or an interval of 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, or 12 hours. Notifications need permission, but declining them does not prevent timing. Locking the phone or leaving the app stops active time accumulation; iOS can still deliver scheduled reminders.
